network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs under bubblewrap with a read-only host root, a fresh writable temporary bind, a cleared environment, and an unshared network namespace. The outer Python checker performs only local file, hash, Git, and process checks.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line reconciliation summary bound in release-receipt.json

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe authenticates current inputs, replays the exact statement plus conditional and elementary partial bodies at trust zero, and checks a negative release decision. It reuses pinned warm artifacts. It cannot accept the validation dependency, serialize an independently reviewed expression fingerprint, close any substantive obligation or the exact root, supply H0/R0 or complete provenance/TCB evidence, perform a clean cold/offline release build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release/master acceptance.
